item.name: 4 Kuttu Aloo Paratha + curd + Aloo sabzi
item.desc: Enjoy a delicious Navratri fasting combo featuring golden kuttu aloo parathas served with vrat wale aloo and refreshing plain curd. A satisfying meal prepared with fasting-friendly ingredients and sendha namak, without onion or garlic.
item.search_alias: Navratri Special Menu Navratri Combo Meals

item.name: 4 Kuttu Paratha with Curd
item.desc: Enjoy a freshly prepared kuttu paratha, cooked until golden and served with a side of cool, creamy curd. A wholesome Navratri fasting meal made with fasting-friendly ingredients and sendha namak, without onion or garlic.
item.search_alias: Navratri Special Menu Navratri Combo Meals

item.name: 4 Kuttu Poori with Aloo Sabzi
item.desc: Enjoy crispy golden kuttu pooris served with delicious vrat wale aloo sabzi, seasoned with fasting-friendly spices and sendha namak. A satisfying traditional Navratri meal, prepared without onion or garlic.
item.search_alias: Navratri Special Menu Navratri Combo Meals

item.name: Vrat Special Thali
item.desc: Celebrate Navratri with our delicious Vrat Special Thali, featuring crispy kuttu pooris, vrat wale aloo sabzi, creamy curd. A satisfying festive meal prepared with fasting-friendly ingredients and sendha namak, without onion or garlic.
item.search_alias: Navratri Special Menu Navratri Combo Meals

item.name: Roasted Makhana
item.desc: Enjoy crunchy roasted makhana, lightly seasoned with fasting-friendly spices for a delicious and satisfying snack. Perfect for Navratri vrat or guilt-free munching, with a delightful crunch in every bite.
item.search_alias: Navratri Special Menu Vrat Snacks & Sweets

item.name: Fruit Chaat
item.desc: A refreshing mix of freshly cut red apples and sweet bananas, served without masala or added spices. A simple, naturally sweet and wholesome fruit snack, perfect for enjoying during Navratri fasting.
item.search_alias: Navratri Special Menu Vrat Snacks & Sweets

item.name: Vrat Ki Khichdi
item.desc: Enjoy comforting vrat chawal ki khichdi made with samak rice, tender potatoes, cumin and fresh coriander. Lightly seasoned and full of traditional flavour, this wholesome dish is perfect for Navratri fasting.
item.search_alias: Navratri Special Menu Vrat Snacks & Sweets

item.name: Plain Curd
item.desc: Enjoy fresh, creamy plain curd with a smooth texture and refreshing taste. A perfect accompaniment to your meal, vrat ki khichdi, paratha or any Indian thali.
item.search_alias: Navratri Special Menu Vrat Snacks & Sweets

item.name: Kuttu Aloo Paratha
item.desc: A delicious fasting-special paratha made with kuttu (buckwheat) flour and flavorful mashed potato stuffing, seasoned with sendha namak and vrat-friendly spices. Cooked in ghee and served hot.

item.name: Plain Kuttu Paratha
item.desc: A delicious traditional Kuttu Paratha made with nutritious buckwheat flour, seasoned with sendha namak and cooked to golden perfection. A simple, wholesome and tasty choice for your Navratri fasting meals.

item.name: 4 Kuttu Poori
item.desc: Crispy and delicious Kuttu Poori made with buckwheat flour and sendha namak. Deep-fried to golden perfection, these traditional Navratri fasting pooris are a tasty treat for your vrat meals.

item.name: Vrat wale Aloo
item.desc: Delicious vrat wale aloo made with tender potatoes, mild fasting spices, sendha namak and fresh coriander. A flavourful Navratri special, prepared without onion or garlic and perfect for your fasting meals.

item.name: Vrat Aloo sabzi Gravy
item.desc: Enjoy tender potatoes simmered in a flavourful, lightly spiced gravy, garnished with fresh coriander. A comforting Navratri fasting special prepared with sendha namak and vrat-friendly spices, without onion or garlic.

item.name: Kuttu Aloo Pakori ( 8-16 pcs)
item.desc: Enjoy crispy, golden potato pakoras coated in kuttu (buckwheat) flour batter and fried to perfection. A delicious Navratri fasting snack seasoned with sendha namak and served with refreshing green chutney. No onion or garlic.

item.name: South Indian Poha (Full)
item.desc: A delightful twist on the classic poha, this South Indian version features soft, flattened rice sauteed with mustard seeds, curry leaves and a hint of tangy tamarind. Infused with the earthy flavors of roasted peanuts, green chillies and aromatic spices, it is garnished with freshly grated coconut and a sprinkle of chopped coriander for a vibrant finish.

item.name: Paneer Butter Masala
item.desc: Paneer cubes in a creamy tomato gravy, flavored with aromatic spices.

item.name: Dal Tadka
item.desc: Lentils tempered with garlic, cumin and red chilli, served with steamed rice.

item.name: Dal Fry
item.desc: A comforting Indian classic made with perfectly cooked lentils, tempered with aromatic spices, onion, tomatoes, garlic and fresh herbs. Rich, flavorful and homestyle best enjoyed with roti, naan or steamed rice.

item.name: Aloo Jeera Masala
item.desc: Aloo jeera is a simple yet flavorful Indian dish made with boiled potatoes and roasted cumin seeds. It’s a popular vegetarian side dish in indian cuisine and can be enjoyed with various types of bread (like roti or paratha) or rice dishes.

item.name: Paneer Do Pyaaza
item.desc: This classic North Indian delicacy offers a perfect balance of tangy, spicy and savory flavors. Best enjoyed with hot butter naan or steamed rice, paneer do pyaaz is a treat for all paneer lovers.

item.name: Paneer Lababdar
item.desc: This North Indian delicacy offers a mildly spiced, velvety flavor that pairs beautifully with butter naan, paratha or steamed rice. Paneer lababdar is a rich and satisfying treat that delights every palate.

item.name: Peri Peri Fries
item.desc: Crispy golden fries tossed in spicy and flavorful peri peri seasoning.

item.name: Matar Paneer
item.desc: Soft paneer cubes and tender green peas cooked in a rich, flavorful tomato, onion gravy with aromatic Indian spices. A comforting North Indian classic, perfect with roti, naan or rice.

item.name: Aloo Sabzi with Gravy
item.desc: Soft, tender potatoes cooked in a flavorful, aromatic onion-tomato gravy with traditional Indian spices. A comforting, homestyle dish that pairs perfectly with roti, paratha, puri, or rice.

item.name: 4 Puri + Aloo Sabzi
item.desc: 4 hot and fluffy puris served with delicious, mildly spiced aloo sabzi. Perfect for a hearty meal.

item.name: 6 Puri + Aloo Sabzi
item.desc: 6 freshly prepared puris paired with flavorful aloo sabzi. A filling and satisfying meal for a bigger appetite.

item.name: 6 Puri + Sabzi + Raita
item.desc: Hot and fluffy puris with homestyle aloo sabzi, served with refreshing creamy raita for the perfect combination.

item.name: 4 Special Puri + Sabzi
item.desc: A special Foody Bhai-style puri meal with crispy puris, flavorful masala aloo sabzi and delicious accompaniments.

item.name: Steam Rice
item.desc: Special boiled rice in home cooked style.

item.name: Jeera Rice
item.desc: Fragrant, long grain basmati rice cooked to perfection and tempered with earthy cumin seeds (jeera) in ghee, infusing each grain with a subtle nutty aroma. Lightly seasoned and garnished with fresh coriander, jeera rice is a simple yet flavorful accompaniment that pairs beautifully with rich curries, dals or as a wholesome dish on it is own.

item.name: Fried Rice
item.desc: Aromatic basmati rice stir fried with fresh vegetables, flavorful sauces and authentic Chinese spices. A delicious and satisfying meal packed with taste in every bite.

item.name: Tawa Roti with Butter
item.desc: Soft, freshly prepared whole wheat tawa roti, generously topped with rich, melted butter for a delicious homemade taste. Perfectly pairs with curry, dal and vegetables for a wholesome meal.

item.name: Tawa Roti Ghee Wali
item.desc: Soft, freshly prepared whole wheat tawa rotis generously brushed with pure ghee for a rich aroma and authentic homemade taste.

item.name: Tawa Roti
item.desc: Soft, thin and wholesome, tawa roti is a classic Indian flatbread made from freshly kneaded whole wheat flour and cooked on a hot griddle (tawa) to golden perfection.

item.name: Plain Butter Paratha
item.desc: Plain butter paratha is a type of Indian flatbread that is crispy on the outside and soft on the inside, made with layers of dough brushed with butter. The dough, typically made from wheat flour, is rolled out, spread with butter, folded and rolled again to create flaky layers.

item.name: Plain Paneer Paratha
item.desc: Soft and flaky whole wheat flatbread stuffed with a mildly spiced filling of crumbled paneer, flavored with a hint of cumin, coriander and fresh green chillies. Cooked to golden perfection on a hot griddle with a touch of ghee, this wholesome paratha is perfect for breakfast, lunch or dinner.

item.name: Paneer Paratha with Butter
item.desc: Paneer paratha with butter is a delicious, stuffed Indian flatbread filled with a spicy paneer (Indian cottage cheese) mixture and cooked with butter for a rich flavor. The dough is made from whole wheat flour, while the filling includes grated paneer mixed with spices like cumin, green chilies, coriander leaves, salt and sometimes onions or garam masala for added taste.

item.name: Aloo Paratha
item.desc: Aloo paratha is a popular North Indian flatbread stuffed with a spiced potato filling, making it a hearty and flavorful dish. The dough is made from whole wheat flour, while the filling consists of mashed potatoes mixed with spices like cumin, coriander powder, red chilli powder, garam masala, green chilies and fresh coriander leaves.

item.name: Aloo Pyaaz Paratha
item.desc: Aloo pyaaz paratha is a popular North Indian stuffed flatbread filled with a spiced mixture of mashed potatoes and onions. Made with whole wheat flour, the dough is rolled out and filled with the flavorful potato-onion mix, which typically includes spices like cumin, coriander powder, red chilli powder, green chillies, garam masala and fresh coriander leaves.

item.name: Gobi Paratha
item.desc: A hearty and flavorful Indian flatbread stuffed with a spiced mixture of finely grated cauliflower (gobi), seasoned with aromatic spices, green chillies and fresh coriander. Cooked on a hot tawa with a drizzle of ghee, this golden brown paratha is crispy on the outside and soft on the inside.

item.name: Mixed Veggie Paratha
item.desc: Soft and flaky whole wheat flatbreads stuffed with a delicious mixed of finely chopped and spiced vegetables, including carrots, peas, potatoes and onion. Each paratha is cooked to golden perfection on a hot griddle, delivering a wholesome, flavorful bite in every layer.

item.name: Aloo Paneer Pyaaz Paratha
item.desc: A hearty and flavorful stuffed paratha, packed with a delicious mixture of mashed spiced potatoes (aloo), crumbled paneer, and finely chopped onion. Seasoned with a medley of aromatic spices and herbs, each bite is bursting with comforting flavors and a hint of warmth.

item.name: Royal Aloo Pyaaz Paratha
item.desc: A king sized delight packed with rich, flavorful mashed potatoes, aromatic spices and a touch of royal indulgence. Each bite of this extra large paratha bursts with homely warmth and authentic North Indian taste, perfectly crisped on the outside and soft inside. A hearty meal fit for a royal appetite.

item.name: Red Sauce Pasta
item.desc: Red sauce pasta is a popular Italian dish made with pasta served in a flavorful, tangy tomato based sauce. The sauce is typically made by simmering ripe tomatoes, garlic, onion, olive oil and various herbs such as basil, oregano and thyme. Sometimes, red bell peppers, chilli flakes or a touch of sugar are added to balance the acidity of the tomatoes.

item.name: Masala Macaroni
item.desc: The dish begins with boiled macaroni pasta, which is then sautéed with a mixture of onion, tomatoes and green chillies. The masala (spice mixed) includes ingredients like turmeric, cumin, coriander, garam masala and sometimes red chili powder, giving it a rich and tangy flavor.

item.name: Bhel Puri North Indian Style (Full)
item.desc: Bhel puri is a popular and tangy snack commonly enjoyed as street food in India. It is a delicious blend of puffed rice, sev and a variety of vegetables, topped with a mixed of tangy and spicy chutneys.

item.name: Plain Maggi
item.desc: Maggi is a popular instant noodle brand loved for its quick preparation and delicious flavor. Known for its signature (2-minute) cooking time, maggi noodles are made with a mix of wheat flour and spices. The noodles come with a spice mix packet that gives it a savory, slightly tangy and mildly spicy taste.

item.name: Mix Veggie Maggi
item.desc: Mixed veggie Maggi is a flavorful and nutritious twist on the classic Maggi noodles. It includes a delicious combination of vegetables such as carrots, peas, beans, corn and bell peppers, all mixed into the noodles. The vegetables add crunch, color, and additional nutrients, making the dish both tasty and healthy.

item.name: Mix Veg Maggie with Butter
item.desc: Hot and delicious Maggi noodles tossed with fresh mixed vegetables, aromatic spices, and a generous touch of creamy butter. A flavorful, comforting and satisfying snack perfect for any time of the day!

item.name: Peri Peri Maggi
item.desc: Hot and delicious Maggi noodles tossed with bold peri peri seasoning, aromatic spices, fresh vegetables, and a hint of tangy chilli flavor. A spicy, flavorful and satisfying twist on your classic Maggi!

item.name: Fresh Kheera, Tomato & Onion Salad
item.desc: Freshly sliced cucumber (kheera), juicy tomatoes, and onion rings, lightly seasoned and served fresh. A healthy and refreshing side dish that perfectly complements your meal. Serves 1 person (approx. 120–150 g).

item.name: Kheera Salad
item.desc: Freshly sliced cucumber (kheera), lightly seasoned and served fresh. A cool and refreshing side dish. Serves 1 person (approx. 80–100 g).

item.name: Onion Salad
item.desc: Fresh onion rings served with light seasoning. A classic accompaniment that adds crunch and flavor to every meal. Serves 1 person (approx. 80–100 g).

item.name: Tomato Salad
item.desc: Juicy tomato slices, freshly cut and lightly seasoned. A healthy and refreshing side dish. Serves 1 person (approx. 80–100 g).

item.name: Boondi Raita
item.desc: Creamy yogurt mixed with crispy boondi and seasoned with roasted cumin, black salt, and fresh coriander for a refreshing side.

item.name: Mix Veg Raita
item.desc: Thick, chilled yogurt blended with fresh cucumber, onion, tomato, and mild Indian spices for a healthy accompaniment.

item.name: Plain Raita
item.desc: Smooth and creamy chilled yogurt lightly seasoned with roasted cumin and a pinch of salt. A simple yet perfect side for every meal.

item.name: Masala Shikanji
item.desc: A traditional Indian lemonade made with fresh lemon juice, chilled water, and a blend of aromatic spices. Sweet, tangy, and refreshing, this classic drink is served cold and is perfect for beating the heat. Serves 1 person • Approx. 250–300 ml.

item.name: Dal Chawal Combo
item.desc: Dal chawal is a well balanced, nutritious meal, loved for its simplicity and comforting flavors. It is a staple in many Indian households, often enjoyed with a side of pickles. The combination is considered not only delicious but also filling and wholesome.

item.name: Dal with 4 Roti
item.desc: The combination of dal and roti is not only filling but also a balanced meal, with the dal providing proteins and fiber, while the roti offers carbohydrates. It is commonly served with a side of pickle or yogurt for added flavor.

item.name: Dal with Chawal and 4 Roti
item.desc: Enjoy a wholesome and comforting Indian meal featuring creamy yellow dal prepared with aromatic spices, served with steamed basmati rice and four soft whole wheat rotis. Accompanied by fresh onion slices, green chili, and lemon wedges, this satisfying combo is perfect for lunch or dinner and delivers authentic homemade flavors in every bite.

item.name: Paneer Butter Masala with 4 Roti
item.desc: Paneer butter masala is a rich, creamy, and mildly spiced curry made with soft cubes of paneer (Indian cottage cheese) cooked in a luscious tomato based gravy with butter, cream and a blend of aromatic spices like garam masala.

item.name: Aloo Jeera Masala With Raita and 4 Roti
item.desc: Flavorful aloo jeera masala served with 4 soft, freshly prepared rotis. A wholesome, homestyle vegetarian meal made with authentic Indian spices.

item.name: Red Sauce Pasta + Macroni
item.desc: Delicious pasta and macaroni tossed in a rich, tangy red tomato sauce, blended with aromatic herbs, spices, and fresh vegetables. A flavorful, cheesy and comforting Italian-style treat, perfect for a quick and satisfying meal.

item.name: Paneer Masala + 4 roti + Salad
item.desc: A delicious combination of rich and flavorful Paneer Masala served with 4 freshly made rotis and a refreshing salad. A wholesome and satisfying meal

item.name: Dal + 4 Roti + Jeera Aloo + salad
item.desc: A wholesome and satisfying meal featuring flavorful homestyle dal, 4 freshly made rotis, delicious jeera aloo, and a refreshing fresh salad. A perfect combination for a complete and comforting meal!

item.name: Dal + Chawal + salad
item.desc: A comforting and wholesome meal of flavorful homestyle dal served with freshly cooked steamed rice and a refreshing salad. A simple, delicious, and satisfying combination!

item.name: Plain Raita
item.desc: Smooth and creamy chilled yogurt lightly seasoned with roasted cumin and a pinch of salt. A simple yet perfect side for every meal.
